sections.title: Inviting a friend
sections.content: You know *szeretnél* and *szeretnék* with a verb ending in *-ni*: *Szeretnék enni.* The same pattern invites a friend. A party is a *buli*, and *találkozik* means 'meets': *Szeretnél jönni a buliba?* (Would you like to come to the party?) *Szeretnél találkozni szombaton?* (Would you like to meet on Saturday?) To accept, say *Igen, szívesen.* To refuse politely, add *sajnos* (unfortunately): *Sajnos nem.*

items.english: Would you like to come to the party?
Would you like to meet on Saturday?
Anna would like to come to the party.

sections.content: The infinitive of *találkozik* is *találkozni*: the *-ik* ending drops before *-ni*.
